players.bio: Achraf Hakimi Mouh (Arabic: أشرف حكيمي موح; born 4 November 1998) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Morocco national team. He is widely regarded as one of the best defenders in the world. Hakimi began playing for Real Madrid Castilla in 2016 and was promoted to the first-team in 2017.

Désiré Nonka-Maho Doué (born 3 June 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain. He is widely considered to be one of the most talented prospects in European football. Doué is a youth international for France, having played for the national team at the under-17, under-19 and under-21 levels, as well as representing the Olympic team in 2024.

Pedro Fernández Sarmiento (born 12 January 2008), known as Dro Fernández or simply Dro, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as attacking midfielder or left winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.
Fabián Ruiz Peña (born 3 April 1996), simply known as Fabián, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Spain national team.

Ferran Torres is a 26-year-old Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for the French Ligue 1 giants Paris Saint-Germain and the Spain national team. He began his career at Valencia, where he made his senior début in 2017, before moving to Manchester City in 2020 and winning the Premier League championship and the EFL Cup in the 2020–21 season.

Ibrahim Mbaye (born 24 January 2008) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team. Mbaye started his youth career in 2013 at ES Guyancourt before joining Versailles in 2015. In 2018, at the age of 10, he joined the Paris Saint-Germain Academy.

Illia Borysovych Zabarnyi (also spelled Illya Zabarnyi; Ukrainian: Ілля Борисович Забарний; born 1 September 2002) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Ukraine national team. Club career Dynamo Kyiv Zabarnyi is a product of the Dynamo Kyiv youth sportive school from his native city Kyiv.
João Pedro Gonçalves Neves (born 27 September 2004) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.

Khalil Ayari (Arabic: خليل العياري; born 2 February 2005) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain, on loan from Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club Stade Tunisien and the Tunisia national team.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia(Order of Honor) (Georgian: ხვიჩა კვარაცხელია pronounced ; born 12 February 2001) is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Georgia national team. Kvaratskhelia started his senior career playing for Dinamo Tbilisi at age 16, before departing to Rustavi where he spent half a season.
Lucas Lopes Beraldo (born 24 November 2003) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.
Lucas Chevalier (born 6 November 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club psg 2025 .

Lucas Digne (born 20 July 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team. Digne began his career at Lille before joining Paris Saint-Germain in 2013. After spending a season on loan at Roma, he moved to Barcelona in July 2016.

Lucas François Bernard Hernandez (French pronunciation: ; born 14 February 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or full-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team. He is known for his versatility and defensive prowess.

Luis Enrique Martínez García (born 8 May 1970) is a Spanish football manager and former player who is currently the head coach of Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain. A versatile player with good technique, he was capable of playing in several positions but was usually deployed as a midfielder or forward, and was also noted for his temperament and stamina.
Maghnes Akliouche (born 25 February 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.

Marcos Aoás Corrêa (born 14 May 1994), commonly known as Marquinhos, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Paris Saint-Germain and the Brazil national team. Mainly a central defender, he can also play as a right-back or a defensive midfielder.
Matvey Yevgenyevich Safonov ( born 25 February 1999) is a Russian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Russia national team.

Nicolas Cousin (born 11 July 1985) is a retired French professional football player. He previously played for Angers SCO and Paris Saint-Germain at the professional level. Cousin retired at the end of the 2018-19 season, having played 190 games for FC Chartres. He then returned to Paris Saint-Germain in a goalkeeper coaching role, working with the youth teams at the academy.

Nuno Alexandre Tavares Mendes (Portuguese pronunciation: ; born 19 June 2002) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.

Masour Ousmane Dembélé (born 15 May 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team. Born in Vernon, Dembélé began his career at Rennes before joining Dortmund in 2016. He won the DFB-Pokal with die Borussen in the 2016–17 season, scoring a goal in the final.
Quentin Ndjantou Mbitcha (born 23 July 2007) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward, left winger, and attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.
Senny Mayulu (born 17 May 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.

Vítor Machado Ferreira (born 13 February 2000), known as Vitinha (Portuguese pronunciation: ), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.
Warren Zaïre-Emery (born 8 March 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.
Willian Joel Pacho Tenorio (born 16 October 2001) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Ecuador national team.
